g.text: Residue replacement preferences at matched surface charge changes
Rows = control residue; columns = design residue. Colour shows the preferred direction after subtracting the reverse exchange.
Fine-tunes are compared with vanilla ProteinMPNN; GQT and pKAI are compared with unsteered Gibbs sampling.
G-H: blue shading marks E/Q and D/N scaffold-preserving candidates; tan shading marks methionine enrichment routes.
Points = backbones; symbols = challenges 1 (circle), 2 (square), 3 (triangle), 5 (diamond). Black bars = equal-challenge means.
